description: Revert to the most stable configuration (8 layers, 128 head dim, 128 batch size) and reduce the matrix learning rate to 0.055 to maximize stability and convergence quality within the 5-minute budget, as previous attempts to increase the LR or batch size resulted in higher validation loss or crashes, and the current best result (0.9881) was achieved at 0.06 but slight increases caused divergence.
